decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to utilize Arclight Phoenix as a powerful recurring threat while also utilizing spells like Pieces of the Puzzle, Strategic Planning, and Consider to fuel graveyard recursion and card advantage. With a focus on tempo and efficiency, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a mix of burn spells and powerful flyers like Crackling Drake. The inclusion of cards like Temporal Trespass and Treasure Cruise allows for additional card draw and late-game pressure. The mana base is carefully constructed to support these strategies and ensure consistent performance.

The deck focuses on casting multiple spells in a turn to trigger the Arclight Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard to the battlefield. It also utilizes cards like Thing in the Ice and Temporal Trespass to control the board and close out the game quickly. The deck's goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and card advantage, using efficient spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to clear the way for its powerful creatures. The land base includes special lands like Otawara, Soaring City and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to help cast spells and activate abilities.

This deck is focused on playing aggressively with flying spirits and tempo plays, using cards like Empyrean Eagle and Supreme Phantom to pump up your creatures. Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition provide disruption to your opponent's game plan, while Collected Company allows you to quickly refill your board with more threats. The mana base is set up to allow for a smooth curve and consistent access to all colors needed for your creatures' abilities. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm your opponent quickly with powerful flying spirits.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures, sacrificing them to trigger various effects like Drain life and damage to the opponent, and creating a recurring loop with Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven to chip away at the opponent's life total. It also utilizes cards like Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute to disrupt the opponent's board and advance its game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless stream of threats and value generation while controlling the board through removal spells like Fatal Push.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish a sacrificial engine using cards like Witch's Oven, Cauldron Familiar, and Mayhem Devil. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar, players can trigger abilities that deal damage to their opponent and gain value from cards like Village Rites and Deadly Dispute. The addition of Ob Nixilis, the Adversary and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provides additional threats and disruption to control the game while using the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional mana ramp and flexibility. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with early aggression and efficient sacrifice synergies.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost, aggressive creatures to quickly overwhelm and outpace the opponent. By protecting these creatures with spells like Gods Willing and Homestead Courage, the deck aims to maintain board presence and deal consistent damage. Dreadhorde Arcanist allows for recursion of spells, providing additional value. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion ensures access to additional mana, supporting the aggressive playstyle of the deck. Overall, the Boros Aggro deck aims to be fast, consistent, and resilient in its pursuit of victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, using a combination of removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore to control the board while attacking with efficient threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and finish the game quickly with powerful finishers like Chandra, Torch of Defiance and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Additionally, the deck has some recursion with cards like Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to provide additional value throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to consistently tutor for powerful creatures and lock down opponent's board with disruptive enchantments and removal spells. It leverages the companion Yorion to generate card advantage and gain incremental value with ETB triggers. The deck aims to control the game by manipulating the board state, ramping with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, and ultimately overpowering the opponent with its diverse array of threats.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing small, aggressive creatures like Dreadhorde Arcanist, Favored Hoplite, and Monastery Swiftspear to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By protecting these creatures with spells like Gods Willing and Homestead Courage, and boosting their power with cards like Invigorated Rampage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish a strong defense. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and mana ramp. Overall, this deck seeks to maintain pressure and tempo throughout the game to secure a fast victory.

The focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced aggressive strategy using Azorius Spirits. By leveraging tempo plays and flying creatures, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence with efficient threats like Ascendant Spirit and Supreme Phantom. Cards like Curious Obsession provide card advantage while Shacklegeist and Rattlechains offer disruption and protection. With a mix of spirits and counter spells, the deck aims to control the board while applying pressure to the opponent, ultimately securing victory through a relentless tempo-driven game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects and synergy between creatures like Cauldron Familiar, Mayhem Devil, and Voldaren Epicure to generate value and deal incremental damage to the opponent. Additionally, cards like Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push help control the board while Village Rites and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary provide card advantage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds flexibility to the deck, allowing for a consistent source of mana ramp. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong board presence through sacrificing creatures for maximum value.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and The Wandering Emperor to control the game. With a suite of counterspells like Absorb, Dovin's Veto, and Censor, along with board wipes like Supreme Verdict, the deck aims to disrupt and dismantle opponent's strategies. Card advantage is also key with cards like Memory Deluge and shark tokens from Shark Typhoon. The deck also includes removal in the form of Portable Hole and Fateful Absence to deal with threats. The mana base is designed to support the control elements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of the deck is to aggressively deploy Arclight Phoenixes onto the battlefield while utilizing cards like Ledger Shredder, Pieces of the Puzzle, and Strategic Planning to fill the graveyard with spells to bring them back. The deck also includes card draw and cantrips like Opt and Treasure Cruise to ensure a steady stream of spells to trigger the Phoenix's return. Lightning Axe provides removal, while Galvanic Iteration can copy key spells for added value. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with constant threats and efficient spellcasting.

This deck focuses on building a strong board presence of Human creatures quickly to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. By utilizing cards like Collected Company and Thalia's Lieutenant, along with powerful Human creatures like General Kudro of Drannith and Luminarch Aspirant, the deck aims to establish dominance on the battlefield early on. With a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive spells like Reflector Mage and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game while maintaining a steady onslaught of damage to secure victory.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly play efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Tenth District Legionnaire to apply pressure on the opponent. Spells like Defiant Strike and Reckless Rage provide additional damage and removal, while protection spells like Gods Willing and Sejiri Shelter help protect your creatures. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, using combat tricks and efficient creatures to control the board and deal damage quickly.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to establish control over the game using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck aims to control the board with sweepers like Supreme Verdict and win through incremental advantage from repeated card draw with The Wandering Emperor and Memory Deluge. It also uses lands like Field of Ruin to disrupt the opponent's mana base and keep them off balance. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the game and outlasting opponents in a grindy matchup.
